fields.description: The project_id from the service account JSON, used in the FCM send URL.

fields.description: Used when a send does not name a project. Exactly one project must be the default.
fields.label: Is Default

fields.description: Site Config reads site_config.json key fcm_service_account_{project name}, so the key never touches the database. Preferred on Frappe Cloud.
fields.label: Credentials Source

fields.description: Upload the JSON downloaded from Firebase Console. It is read, encrypted and the uploaded file is then deleted.

fields.description: Alternative to uploading. Cleared on save - the value is encrypted before it is written, so it is never stored here.
fields.label: …or paste the JSON here

fields.description: Which key is currently stored. Shown so the credential can be identified without revealing it.
fields.label: Stored Credential

fields.description: Sound file bundled in the client app, e.g. cash_notification.wav
fields.label: Default Sound

fields.description: iOS bundle identifier, sent as the apns-topic header.
fields.label: APNS Bundle Id

fields.description: Subscribe devices to derived topics (all, platform, language, role) as they register.
fields.label: Auto Subscribe Topics

fields.description: How long a batch worker may wait on the rate limiter before requeueing itself.
fields.label: Throttle Max Block (sec)
